### Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

"https://towardsdatascience.com/how-to-automatically-import-and-combine-multiple-files-in-r-30a77c0a7732/"
```


### Load files
```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/07092025/do_xlsx_files")


do <- data.frame()

for (file in files){
  name <- gsub(".xlsx","", file)
  do_file <- readxl::read_excel(paste("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/07092025/do_xlsx_files/",file,sep=""))
  do_file$sensor <- name
  do <- rbind(do, do_file)
}

colnames(do) <- c("datetime", "DO", "temp", "DO_adj", "sensor")

```

```{r}
do$do_sensor <- substr(do$sensor, start = 8, stop = 9)
do$do_sensor <- gsub('_','',do$do_sensor)
do_sensor_key <- read_excel("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/do_sensor_key.xlsx")

do_sensor_key$do_sensor <- as.character(do_sensor_key$do_sensor)
do <- left_join(do, do_sensor_key, by = "do_sensor")

```




```{r}
do_current <- left_join(do, current, by = "datetime")

do_current$up_Immersed <- ifelse(do_current$up_speed < 10, "Y", "N" )
do_current$low_Immersed <- ifelse(do_current$low_speed < 10, "Y", "N" )

do_current %>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()

do_current %>%
  filter(low_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()

```



```{r}
do_current %>%
  filter(bag == c(93:100))%>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
do_current %>%
  filter(bag == c(43:46, 27:30))%>%
  filter(low_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
do_mean <- do_current %>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  group_by(datetime, density, tide) %>%
  summarize(mean_DO = mean(DO_adj))
  
```

```{r}
do_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "L") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(2,20)
```
```{r}
do_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(2,20)
```

```{r}
do_mean_wide <- do_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = density, values_from = mean_DO)

# Calculate differences
do_diff <- do_mean_wide %>%
  group_by(tide)%>%
  mutate(D_diff = D - C,
         S_diff = S - C) 
  
```

```{r}
do_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime))+
  geom_point(aes(y=D_diff), color = "yellow")+
  geom_point(aes(y =S_diff), color = "green")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```

```{r}

do_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "L") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime))+
  geom_point(aes(y=D_diff), color = "yellow")+
  geom_point(aes(y =S_diff), color = "green")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```
